data.prompt: Female Chinese opera-pop, 74BPM, D minor pentatonic. The singing MUST sound like real 京剧旦角 plus 昆曲水磨腔, not generic pop with a little slide. Verse: restrained 昆曲, slow 水磨腔, each character polished, breath pauses 气口, gentle 小腔 ornaments, like 青衣 narrating while watching him at night. Chorus: 京剧西皮/二黄 flavored 悲腔, long 拖腔 on 雾色漫过层台 and 霜色铺满长阶, nasal head resonance, curved melisma, kunqu-style slides ~ between notes, tearful but pitched, never shout. Bridge: 昆曲转 京剧, still fully sung, no 念白, no 京白, no talking. Interlude: jinghu 京胡 and kunqu 笛子 lead, plus 月琴, 板鼓, small gong, then guzheng space; pipa fill ends with one silent bar. Female opera vocal only, in tune, 赤伶-level 戏腔 but softer like a wife sighing. No spoken word, no male voice, no rap, no EDM, no sudden rock. Arrangement stays tender: no war drums, no long suona melody, erhu/jinghu answers the vocal in chorus.
